title: Non-Autoregressive TTS with Explicit Duration Modelling for Low-Resource Highly Expressive Speech
abstract: We present a method for building highly expressive TTS voices with as little as 15 minutes of speech data from a target speaker. By moving from an autoregressive attention-based TTS model to a non-autoregressive architecture with an external duration model and conditional GAN fine-tuning, we close the gap to recordings by 23.3% for naturalness and 16.3% for speaker similarity, matching a full-data (~10 hour) Tacotron2 baseline with only 15 minutes of audio.
